name: Reiwa Accounting Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: Reiwa Accounting Holdings Co., Ltd. provides consulting services focused on accounting operations and business management in Japan. It provides payroll calculation, temporary staffing, recruitment, accounting, bookkeeping certification, labor management, labor consulting, and other business process outsourcing services, as well as planning and running training and seminars on accounting practices.
